verdict.rationale: TaxJar's AutoFile files state returns and remits payments, says deadlines are never missed, and migrates state reports into returns, so the filing and remittance capability exists. The evidence shows no ops-facing view of that filing picture, however. Missing for 10: a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status tracking, visibility into amounts remitted per return, downloadable filing confirmations, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
